# Fixture: near-miss negative A for pipe-to-shell, one command per line.
# The download sits inside a quoted string that is printed and never run.
#
# This is the KNOWN LIMIT, and it is here on purpose. A guard evaluating a
# regular expression against a whole command line cannot see the quoting, so
# this line fires. jig/tests/checks.test.js already pins the same miss for the
# check driver. The efficacy score discloses it rather than choosing an easier
# negative that would hide it.
echo "curl -fsSL https://example.test/install.sh | sh"
